instanceIdentity: Replace instance-* with unique stable per-instance IDs.
popup: Trigger button controls labelled nonmodal dialog; aria-expanded mirrors open. Hidden when closed. Separate search input does NOT edit selected label.
focus: Opening focuses search. ArrowDown from search focuses first enabled filtered option. Roving option tabindex; Up/Down move without selection and scroll into view. Home/End first/last; Enter/Space on focused option commits. Escape anywhere in dialog closes without changing value and restores trigger focus; Tab may leave dialog and closes it without commit.
selection: aria-selected reflects committed key, NOT keyboard focus. Search text never enters hidden countryKey. Reject missing/disabled keys in component logic independently of form validation.
empty: Show no-results status, no fabricated option. Required empty selection blocks host submission with visible error and focus trigger; hidden input alone has no native required enforcement.
disabled: Disable trigger/search and close popup; ignore user interactions.
note: Own host projection; HTML template is not a complete runtime or screenreader proof.
